title: Spiced Brik Patties
description: A twist on traditional Indian street food, these spiced brik patties are a flavorful and crispy snack.

ingredients.name: Meat
ingredients.notes: ground lamb or beef work well

ingredients.name: Tunisian spices
ingredients.notes: a blend of cumin, coriander, and cinnamon

ingredients.name: Resting time
ingredients.notes: for the brik to rest before frying

instructions: 1. Preheat oil in a deep frying pan to 375°F (190°C).
2. In a large bowl, combine meat, Tunisian spices, fluffy onion, and intense tomato. Mix well.
3. Cut brik pastry into small squares and place a spoonful of the meat mixture in the center of each square.
4. Fold the pastry squares in half to form triangles and press the edges together to seal.
5. Fry the brik patties in batches until golden brown, about 3-4 minutes on each side.
6. Remove the patties from the oil and place them on a paper towel-lined plate to drain excess oil.
7. Serve the brik patties hot with your favorite chutney or sauce.
